description: This Java source file defines the BytesToBytesMap class, an append-only hash map implementation used in Apache Spark for storing key-value pairs where keys and values are contiguous byte regions. It includes memory management, iteration, spilling, and rehashing functionalities, and is optimized for large-scale data processing within Spark's unsafe memory operations.

classes.name: BytesToBytesMap
classes.description: A high-performance, append-only hash map for byte key-value pairs, supporting large data volumes and spill-over in Spark.

classes.name: BytesToBytesMap.Location
classes.description: A handle representing a specific key-value pair location within the map, supporting key/value access and appending.

classes.name: BytesToBytesMap.MapIterator
classes.description: An iterator over the map entries, providing thread-safe traversal with optional destructive memory freeing.

classes.name: BytesToBytesMap.MapIteratorWithKeyIndex
classes.description: An iterator that traverses keys by index in the hash array, with non-thread-safe behavior.

methods.name: numKeys
methods.description: Returns the number of keys stored in the map.

methods.name: numValues
methods.description: Returns the total number of values stored, including multiple values per key.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe iterator over the map entries.

methods.name: destructiveIterator
methods.description: Creates a destructive iterator that frees pages as it iterates.

methods.name: iteratorWithKeyIndex
methods.description: Creates an iterator that traverses keys by index, not thread-safe.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Looks up a key and returns a Location handle for existence and data access.

methods.name: safeLookup
methods.description: Thread-safe key lookup with explicit hash.

methods.name: getTotalMemoryConsumption
methods.description: Returns total memory used by the map structures.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the map to its initial state, freeing memory.

methods.name: growAndRehash
methods.description: Doubles the hash table size and rehashes entries for capacity expansion.
